The head coach was [[John Pelphrey]], serving in his third year. The team played its home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas|Fayetteville]], [[Arkansas]] and are members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 14–18, 7–9 in SEC play and lost in the first round of the [[2010 SEC men's basketball tournament]]. ==2009–10 Roster== It was announced on July 5 that Jason Henry would not return to the hardwood for the Razorbacks this fall."Henry will not return to basketball team." 7/5/2009.
